parameters.content:
## Output guardrails

Generate, then check with deterministic rules and a second model call. On failure, rewrite once and check the rules again. If it still fails, return a fixed safe sentence and do not return the model text.

Rules: not empty, at most 1200 characters, no email, no phone, none of the banned phrases in Config (separated by |).

The judge also rejects definitive legal or medical advice and any request to reveal credentials.

assignments.name: bannedPhrases
assignments.value: as an ai language model|ignore previous instructions|system prompt

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ allowed: true, rewritten: false, text: $json.draft, reasons: [] }) }}
